Batch 43’s 11 draft items, YAML-only A/B pages, source coverage, dependency evidence, and proof contracts are authored. The finite-width atomlessness issue and proposed owner reconciliation are recorded in the [batch notes](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/machine-learning-all-101-2026-10-19-batch-43.notes.md).

The math escalation is that an IID symmetric atomless ReLU layer has probability \(2^{-n}\) of producing an all-zero activation vector. A following zero-bias preactivation then has an atom at zero, so the backward half-factor cannot be assumed to propagate through every finite layer. The backward ReLU and PReLU results are stated as fixed-layer formulas.
